en.text:
Hitting a target with 18 pellets in a burst grants your next Melee attack within 3 seconds 300% Additional Base Melee Damage.

Dealing Melee Damage grants 'Saint's Fury' for 8.5 seconds, providing the folllowing:
• 35% increased weapon damage 
• 15% decreased Charge Time
• ? Increased Reload Speed

Saint's Fury can be refreshed by melee damage and is removed on stow.
